title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Courtesy Bonus Award for FilterDirect Shipments
content:
A courtesy-program customer's filter deliveries earn a courtesy bonus award toward the courtesy rate on a paid tune-up under Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The record read is the shipment entries of the customer's subscription under FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions, by ship date.

**Counting window.** The FilterDirect shipments counted toward the courtesy rate are those of the last 24 months. A shipment is within the last 24 months while fewer than 24 whole calendar months have passed from its ship date to the date of handling.

**Rule.** Four or more shipments counted earn a courtesy bonus award of 3 points. One to three earn an award of 2 points. None earn no award.

| FilterDirect shipments in the last 24 months | Courtesy bonus award |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 3 points |
| 1 to 3 | 2 points |
| 0 | None |

## Boundaries

- 4 shipments earn 3 points. 3 shipments earn 2.
- A shipment 23 whole months and some days ago is counted. One 24 whole months ago is not.

## Example (hypothetical)

A customer receives a shipment every quarter. Shipments 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 20 and 23 months ago are all inside the window, so 8 are counted and 3 points are earned.
